yast.importMssqlConnections: Import Connections from SQL Server Extension
yast.configuration.title: YetAnotherSqlTool
yast.connections: Connection profiles shown in the Object Explorer.
yast.connections.id: The unique identifier for this connection profile.
yast.connections.groupId: The unique identifier for the connection group this connection profile belongs to.
yast.connections.databaseFilter: [Optional] Patterns of the databases this connection shows in the Object Explorer and in the list of databases of an editor, e.g. '*-dev-*'. '*' stands for any text and '?' for one character; separate several patterns with ';'; a pattern starting with '!' hides the databases it matches. Every database is shown when empty.
yast.connections.color: [Optional] Color of this connection ('#RRGGBB'), shown in the status bar and as a bar in the gutter of the SQL editors that use it.
yast.connections.server: [Required] Specify the server name to connect to. Use 'hostname instance' or '<server>.database.windows.net' for Azure SQL Database.
yast.connections.database: [Optional] Specify the database name to connect to. If database is not specified, the default user database setting is used, typically 'master'.
yast.connections.user: [Optional] Specify the user name for SQL Server authentication. If user name is not specified, when you connect, you will be asked again.
yast.connections.password: [Optional] Specify the password for SQL Server authentication. If password is not specified or already saved, when you connect, you will be asked again.
yast.connections.authenticationType: [Optional] Specify the authentication type. Windows authentication ('Integrated') signs in with NTLM: the user is DOMAIN\user and the password is asked for.
yast.connections.authenticationType.enum: Windows Authentication (NTLM with DOMAIN\user and a password)
Microsoft Entra ID - Universal with MFA support
yast.connections.port: [Optional] Specify the port number to connect to.
yast.connections.encrypt: [Optional] When 'Mandatory' or 'Strict', SQL Server uses SSL encryption for all data sent between the client and server if the server has a certificate installed. When set to 'Strict', SQL Server uses TDS 8.0 for all data transfer between the client and server. 'Strict' is supported on SQL Server 2022 onwards.
yast.connections.trustServerCertificate: [Optional] When set to 'true', the SQL Server SSL certificate is automatically trusted when the communication layer is encrypted using SSL. Set 'false' for Azure SQL Database connection.
yast.connections.hostNameInCertificate: [Optional] When specified (and encrypt=Mandatory and trustServerCertificate=false), SQL Server uses provided hostname for validating trust with the server certificate.
yast.connections.persistSecurityInfo: [Optional] When set to false, security-sensitive information, such as the password, is not returned as part of the connection if the connection is open or has ever been in an open state.
yast.connections.connectTimeout: [Optional] Specify the length of time in seconds to wait for a connection to the server before terminating connection attempt and generating an error. The default value is 30 seconds.
yast.connections.commandTimeout: [Optional] Specify the length of time in seconds to wait for a command to execute before terminating the attempt and generating an error. The default value is 30 seconds.
yast.connections.connectRetryCount: [Optional] Specify the number of attempts to restore connection.
yast.connections.connectRetryInterval: [Optional] Specify the delay between attempts to restore connection.
yast.connections.applicationName: [Optional] Specify the name of the application used for SQL Server to log (default: 'YetAnotherSqlTool').
yast.connections.workstationId: [Optional] Specify the name of the workstation connecting to SQL Server.
yast.connections.applicationIntent: [Optional] Declares the application workload type when connecting to SQL Server such as ReadWrite or ReadOnly. Refer to SQL Server AlwaysOn for more detail.
yast.connections.currentLanguage: [Optional] Indicates the SQL Server language settings.
yast.connections.pooling: [Optional] When set to 'true', the connection object is drawn from the appropriate pool, or if necessary, is created and added to the appropriate pool. Note: May keep serverless databases active and prevent auto-pausing.
yast.connections.maxPoolSize: [Optional] Specify the maximum number of connections allowed in the pool.
yast.connections.minPoolSize: [Optional] Specify the minimum number of connections allowed in the pool.
yast.connections.loadBalanceTimeout: [Optional] Specify the minimum amount of time in seconds for this connection to live in the pool before being removed/deleted.
yast.connections.replication: [Optional] Used by SQL Server in replication.
yast.connections.attachDbFilename: [Optional] Specify the name of the primary file, including the full path name, of an attachable database.
yast.connections.failoverPartner: [Optional] Specify the name or network address of the instance of SQL Server that acts as a failover partner.
yast.connections.multiSubnetFailover: [Optional] When set to 'true', the detection and connection to the active server is faster if AlwaysOn Availability Group is configured on different subnets.
yast.connections.multipleActiveResultSet: [Optional] When set to 'true', multiple result sets can be returned and read from on connection.
yast.connections.packetSize: [Optional] Specify the size in bytes of the network packets to communicate with SQL Server.
yast.connections.typeSystemVersion: [Optional] Indicates which server type the provider will expose through the DataReader.
yast.connections.connectionString: [Optional] The ADO.NET connection string to use for the connection. Overrides any other options given in this connection.
yast.connections.profileName: [Optional] Specify a custom name for this connection profile to easily browse and search in the command palette of Visual Studio Code.
yast.connections.savePassword: [Optional] When set to 'true', the password for SQL Server authentication is saved in the secure store of your operating system such as KeyChain in MacOS or Secure Store in Windows.
yast.connections.emptyPasswordInput: [Optional] Indicates whether this profile has an empty password explicitly set
yast.connections.order: [Optional] A non-negative number used to sort this connection in the Object Explorer sidebar. Connections with an 'order' value are displayed first, lowest to highest; remaining connections follow in alphabetical order.
yast.connections.sslrootcert: [PostgreSQL] Path to the root certificate file.
yast.connectionGroups.name: The name of the connection group.
yast.connectionGroups.id: The unique identifier for the connection group.
yast.connectionGroups.color: The color of the connection group.
yast.connectionGroups.description: The description of the connection group.
yast.connectionGroups.parentId: The unique identifier for the parent connection group.
yast.connectionGroups.order: [Optional] A non-negative number used to sort this connection group in the Object Explorer sidebar. Groups with an 'order' value are displayed first, lowest to highest; remaining groups follow in alphabetical order.
yast.entraId.allowedServers.markdown: Server names, besides Azure's (`*.database.windows.net`, `*.postgres.database.azure.com`...), that may receive a Microsoft Entra ID token: for example a custom DNS name or `localhost` for a tunnel. An entry starting with a dot, such as `.corp.example.com`, allows every name ending with it. A token sent to a server lets that server act as you on your Azure databases for about an hour.
yast.objectExplorer.collapseConnectionGr: When enabled, connection groups will be collapsed instead of expanded at startup.
yast.maxRecentConnections: The maximum number of recently used connections to store in the connection list.
yast.openQueryResultsInTabByDefault: Automatically display query results in a new tab instead of the query pane.
yast.defaultQueryResultsViewMode: Default view mode for query results display.
yast.defaultQueryResultsViewMode.enumDes: Display results in a tabular grid format (default)
Display results in a formatted text format.
yast.messages.copyIncludeTimestamps: When enabled, Copy All in the query result Messages pane includes message timestamps.
yast.resultsFontFamily: Set the font family for the results grid; set to blank to use the editor font
yast.resultsFontSize: Set the font size for the results grid; set to blank to use the editor size
yast.results.openAfterSave: When enabled, saved query result exports are opened after export. Excel exports open with the system file handler; text exports open in VS Code.
yast.saveAsCsv.includeHeaders: [Optional] When true, column headers are included when saving results as CSV
yast.saveAsCsv.delimiter: [Optional] Delimiter for separating data items when saving results as CSV. Choose from common separators like comma (,), tab (\t), semicolon (;), or pipe (|)
yast.saveAsCsv.lineSeparator: [Optional] Character(s) used for separating rows when saving results as CSV
yast.saveAsCsv.textIdentifier: [Optional] Character used for enclosing text fields when saving results as CSV
yast.saveAsCsv.encoding: [Optional] File encoding used when saving results as CSV. Choose from UTF-8 (recommended), UTF-16, ASCII, or Latin-1 based on your target application compatibility
yast.saveAsExcel.includeHeaders: When true, column headers are included when saving results as an Excel file
yast.saveAsExcel.freezeHeaderRow.markdow: **Used when column headers are enabled.** When true, freeze the header row when saving results as an Excel file
yast.saveAsExcel.boldHeaderRow.markdown: **Used when column headers are enabled.** When true, make the header row bold when saving results as an Excel file
yast.saveAsExcel.autoFilterHeaderRow.mar: **Used when column headers are enabled.** When true, enable auto filtering on the header row when saving results as an Excel file
yast.saveAsExcel.autoSizeColumns: When true, attempt to automatically size columns when saving results as an Excel file
yast.copyIncludeHeaders: [Optional] Configuration options for copying results from the Results View
yast.copyRemoveNewLine: [Optional] Configuration options for copying multi-line results from the Results View
yast.showBatchTime: [Optional] Should execution time be shown for individual batches
yast.results.showBatchMessages: [Optional] Show batch start and completion messages, including 'Started executing query at...' and 'Commands completed successfully'.
yast.splitPaneSelection: [Optional] Configuration options for which column new result panes should open in
yast.statusBar.showQueryExecutionStatus: Controls whether the query execution status (executing, canceling, completed) is displayed in the status bar.
yast.statusBar.connectionInfoMaxLength: The maximum number of characters to display for the connection info in the status bar. Set to -1 for no limit.
yast.resultsGrid.autoSizeColumnsMode: Choose how result grid columns are automatically sized (headers + data, data only, or disable auto sizing).
yast.resultsGrid.autoSizeColumnsMode.enu: Use column headers and data to size columns automatically
Use only row data to size columns automatically
Use only column headers to size columns automatically
yast.resultsGrid.inMemoryDataProcessingT: Controls the max number of rows allowed to do filtering and sorting in memory. If the number is exceeded, sorting and filtering will be disabled. Warning: Increasing this may impact performance.
yast.resultsGrid.alternatingRowColors: Enable alternating row background colors (zebra striping) in the results grid. The color is derived from the current VS Code theme.
yast.resultsGrid.freezeFirstColumnByDefa: Freeze the first data column by default in new result grids. Existing saved grid state takes precedence.
yast.resultsGrid.showGridLines: Control which grid lines are visible in the results grid.
yast.resultsGrid.showGridLines.enumDescr: Show both horizontal and vertical grid lines
yast.resultsGrid.rowPadding: Extra vertical padding in pixels added to each row in the results grid, controlling row density. Valid range: 0-10.
yast.resultsGrid.rightAlignNumbers: Right-align values in numeric columns (such as int, decimal, float, and money) in the results grid.
yast.autoRevealResultsPanel: Automatically reveal the results panel when switching to an editor with query results. Only applies when 'Open Results in Tab' is enabled.
yast.query.preventAutoExecuteScript: Prevent automatic execution of scripts (e.g., 'Select Top 1000'). When enabled, scripts will not be automatically executed upon generation.
yast.query.showActiveConnectionAsCodeLen: Show the active SQL connection details as a CodeLens suggestion at the top of the editor for quick visibility.
yast.syntaxHighlighting.engineSpecific: Color the SQL editors connected to a database with the keywords, data types and functions of its engine (PostgreSQL, SQL Server). Editors without a connection keep VS Code's default SQL colors.
yast.semanticTokenTypes.yastKeyword: SQL keyword of the engine of the editor's connection.
yast.semanticTokenTypes.yastType: SQL built-in data type of the engine of the editor's connection.
yast.untrustedWorkspaces.description: Connections and connection groups saved in the workspace settings are ignored until the workspace is trusted.
yast.dashboard.refreshInterval: Starts the server dashboard with Auto refresh on, at this interval in seconds. 0 opens it without auto refresh: it reads the statistics once, then only when Refresh is clicked.
yast.dashboard.refreshInterval.enumDescr: Off: one sample when the dashboard opens, then on demand
